# Text shaping fixtures

`CaretTest.ttf` is a synthetic MIT-licensed fixture generated by
`generate_caret_font.py` using fontTools 4.67.0. Its `fi` ligature has an advance
of 1000 font units and a GDEF caret at 200, so uniform caret division cannot pass
the test. Regeneration uses a fixed timestamp and requires no system fonts.

`NotoSansDevanagari-Regular.ttf` is an unmodified upstream font under the SIL Open
Font License 1.1. Keep `NotoDevanagari-OFL.txt` with every redistributed copy.
`noto-font-source.json` pins the upstream URLs, revisions and SHA-256 hashes.

The complex-script cases cover pre-base vowel reordering, conjunct substitution
and a grapheme whose glyphs span multiple shaping clusters. Expected glyph IDs
refer to this pinned font: `ka-deva` is 56, `k_ssa-deva` is 90, and the contextual
pre-base vowel forms are 545 and 551.

`ShapingReference.ttf` is an OFL-licensed derivative of the pinned Noto font,
renamed and generated by `generate_reference_font.py`. Its private-use mappings
select known final glyphs directly, with GSUB and GPOS removed. This lets cooked
GPU tests compare complex input with an explicit reference without deriving the
expected glyph sequence from the engine. Distribute `NotoDevanagari-OFL.txt` with
this font too. Its original copyright and license metadata are preserved.
